name: a hub diagram and a task list build side by side
looks: A headline claims one shared brain and one execution layer. On the left, a handful of labelled nodes (specs, tasks, repositories, decisions, sessions, tests) draw in around a central mark, thin lines connecting them. On the right, a short list of task rows, each with a small progress bar, fills in one after another, every bar growing to a different length.
build: The hub's nodes fade/scale in around the centre on a light stagger as their connecting lines draw on with strokeDashoffset, outside-in; the centre mark pulses once all nodes land. The task-row bars scaleY/scaleX from a zero origin on an uneven stagger, power3.out, timed to finish alongside the hub.
sound: A soft tick per node landing, a low hum under the connecting lines, a settle chime as both panels finish together.
prompt: Claim that many separate parts share one brain and one execution layer. Draw a small hub diagram of labelled parts connected to a central mark on one side, and build a short list of tasks with their own progress bars on the other, timing both to land together so the claim and its proof finish in the same beat.
